### ToPostgresName(PgDateTimePart)

Gets the field name PostgreSQL's <code>date_part</code>, <code>extract</code> and <code>date_trunc</code> accept, such as
<code>isoyear</code> or <code>dow</code>, for use as a SQL argument.
